descriptionChirho: Qal stem: to dry up, become dry or parched, used intransitively of waters, land, or vegetation drying out.
Pual stem: to be dried up as a completed passive state, indicating a resultative condition of dryness.

labelChirho: cause to dry up, make dry
descriptionChirho: Hifil stem: to cause something to dry up, to make dry or parch, used causatively of God or agents drying up waters or land.
